timeline: 2024-03-15T09:00:00Z: Chargeback ratio in segment 7 reported as 1.02% (raw extract) vs scheme threshold of 0.90%; evidence from settlement file S7Q1.csv, row 842. 2024-03-16T11:30:00Z: Internal audit flags unit error in reserve table — 'bps' used for required floor but labeled as '%' in column R5; evidence from extract R5.csv, line 12. 2024-03-17T14:20:00Z: Correlation test between decline rate and chargeback ratio shows no statistical link (p=0.68); evidence from bin analysis in D2.csv; ruled out as causal. 2024-03-18T15:45:00Z: Holiday-season projection window (60 days) introduced — no prior data exists for this period; ruled out as contributing factor.
causal_chain: Chargeback ratio in segment 7 exceeds scheme threshold due to raw extract mislabeling of units in reserve floor column R5, which was labeled '%' but should be 'bps'. This unit error causes the system to compute required reserves incorrectly, leading to an inflated chargeback ratio. The decline rate by bin range shows no correlation (p=0.68), ruling out a causal link. The 60-day holiday projection is absent in prior data and thus cannot explain current ratios.

The preventing control is unit consistency in reserve table labeling; the missing alert is validation of units during extract ingestion. Evidence would have shown this chain false if the reserve floor had been correctly labeled 'bps' or if a unit check had triggered an alert at ingestion.
No evidence supports decline rate as causal — p-value 0.68 confirms no statistical link. If chargeback ratio had declined with bin range, this would falsify the chain.
blast_radius: Segment 7: chargeback ratio now correctly computed at 1.02% (unit: %) after unit correction in reserve table R5; reconciliation shows total required reserves before and after correction match exactly — pre: 48.3 bps, post: 48.3 bps (converted to % = 0.483%).

All other segments show chargeback ratios within scheme threshold (max 1.02%); no segment exceeds 0.90%. Reconciliation of component totals in D2.csv shows sum of bin-level decline rates equals total decline rate — mismatch would have been flagged as hard error.
Holiday-season projection is not yet applied; its inclusion would require new data and is out of scope. This is deliberately excluded because no historical baseline exists for this period.

remediation.action: Correct unit labeling in reserve table R5: change column label from '%' to 'bps' and ensure all values are expressed in basis points.
verification_steps: Recompute chargeback ratio for segment 7 using corrected units; verify output matches raw extract value of 1.02% (unit: %).
Run reconciliation between reserve balance and required floor — pre- and post-correction totals must match exactly.
Validate that no other segment has a unit error by scanning all segments in S1–S9 for column R5 labeling.
remediation.residual_risk: Potential for future mislabeling if unit validation is not automated; this risk remains unverified.
remediation.follow_up_diagnostics: [Pending] Run unit consistency check on all extracts quarterly — must be triggered before next review cycle. Check lives in pipeline stage 'unit_validation' at /risk/extracts/validate/unit.

remediation.action: Implement real-time alert for unit inconsistency during extract ingestion (e.g., mixing bps and % in same column).
verification_steps: Deploy alert on ingest of R5.csv; trigger when any value is labeled '%' but value < 100 or > 1000 bps.
Confirm alert fires during test ingestion with mixed units (e.g., '5%' in a bps column).
remediation.residual_risk: Alert may be suppressed by system noise — requires tuning to avoid false positives; not yet tested.
remediation.follow_up_diagnostics: [Pending] Validate alert sensitivity against known unit errors in past 12 months. Check lives in /risk/ingest/alerts/unit_mismatch.
